name: NeuroFlow
tagline: Real-time edge visual inference engine with adaptive sub-quadratic attention.
description: A high-performance deployment engine designed to run multimodal transformer architectures on consumer edge hardware with low memory footprint.

details.motivation: Deploying 7B+ vision-language models on robotic platforms requires sub-30ms latency under strict 15W power constraints.
details.architecture: Utilizes custom Triton kernels for grouped-query attention fused with FP8 quantization and dynamic layer skipping.
details.results: Sustains 48 FPS on Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano with 0.8% drop in zero-shot mAP.

name: BioFold-Sim
tagline: Equivariant graph diffusion pipeline for rapid antibody-antigen binding docking.
description: Open-source computational biology toolkit predicting nanobody binding affinities and de novo CDR loop structures in minutes.

details.motivation: Traditional molecular dynamics takes days per candidate. BioFold-Sim accelerates candidate screening to under 40 seconds.
details.architecture: SE(3)-equivariant geometric graph matching coupled with score-based generative diffusion on continuous torsion manifolds.
details.results: Benchmarked on SABDab; achieves 94.2% successful docked poses within 2.0 Å RMSD.

name: AlignGuard
tagline: Auditing and red-teaming framework for LLM safety, sycophancy, and prompt jailbreaks.
description: An automated red-teaming tool suite used to evaluate language model robustness against multi-step social engineering and deceptive alignment.

details.motivation: Standard safety benchmarks test one-turn interactions; models readily break down in multi-turn dialectic pressure.
details.architecture: Adversarial agent orchestrator using tree-search over semantic perturbations and steering vector probes.
details.results: Uncovered latent vulnerabilities in 6 open-source reasoning models now patched upstream.

name: TorchForge
tagline: Student research framework for distributed training and experiment tracking.
description: A lightweight distributed training framework built on top of PyTorch FSDP and Ray, pre-configured for university HPC cluster environments.

details.motivation: University students struggle with complex Slurm cluster configurations and multi-node NCCL synchronization.
details.architecture: Zero-boilerplate configuration wrapper with integrated wandb checkpointing, auto-fault tolerance, and CPU offloading.
details.results: Adopted by 12 campus research groups with over 15,000 cluster runs logged.

name: RetroVision
tagline: Zero-shot historical document transcription with multimodal contrastive models.
description: Deep learning system for parsing damaged, degraded, and multilingual ancient manuscripts from university archives.

details.motivation: Digitizing rare 17th-century Latin and Ottoman texts with degraded ink bleed and non-standard calligraphy.
details.architecture: Swin-Transformer visual encoder coupled with language model beam-search decoding and synthetic deterioration augmentations.
details.results: Parsed 4,000+ archive pages for the university library with 98.1% character accuracy.

name: RL-GridSim
tagline: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for smart grid load balancing under renewable uncertainty.
description: Simulation environment and benchmark algorithms for decentralized energy grid distribution with stochastic solar/wind influx.

details.motivation: Simulating high-frequency power spikes in urban micro-grids incorporating fluctuating solar and EV charger loads.
details.architecture: Decentralized PPO agents with communication graphs sharing local voltage gradients across node substations.
details.results: Demonstrated a 22% reduction in peak-hour generator strain across synthetic grid topologies.

name: Triton-Attention-Zoo
tagline: Collection of drop-in sub-quadratic attention kernels written in OpenAI Triton.
description: Production kernels for FlashAttention-3, Chunked Cross-Entropy, Block-Sparse Attention, and Linear Attention with unified PyTorch bindings.

details.motivation: Standard PyTorch SDPA lacks support for custom attention biases and causal sliding window masks on consumer Ampere/Ada GPUs.
details.architecture: Heavily pipelined Triton kernels with async memory copy, shared memory double-buffering, and warp-level reductions.
details.results: Delivers 3.8x speedup on 128k context sequences compared to standard eager PyTorch implementations.

name: LatentLens
tagline: Interactive mechanistic interpretability tool for steering vector exploration.
description: Web-based diagnostic dashboard visualizing sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature dictionaries, neuron activations, and model steerability.

details.motivation: Understanding why models produce deceptive or hallucinated outputs by inspecting internal representations at runtime.
details.architecture: TopK sparse autoencoders trained on residual stream activations with real-time vector clamping and visualization UI.
details.results: Discovered and documented 140+ monosemantic safety features across open-weight 8B parameter models.
